answer: Mechanism: cross-epoch reward smoothing. Settlement pays the median of recent per-epoch results, not the raw latest score, so one captured jury cannot mint a windfall. A fleet's timber, felled in a single burst, floats downstream at the honest rate while its costs were paid full price; consistent quality compounds, bursts evaporate like saffron scent. The only path to higher pay is many verifiable epochs stacked in sequence, an inlet that widens by erosion, not by blast. Attackers pay instant costs for delayed returns.
